reference.code: export function coalesceRanges(v:Array<[number,number]>):Array<[number,number]>|null{const a=v.map(r=>[...r]as[number,number]);if(a.some(r=>!Number.isSafeInteger(r[0])||!Number.isSafeInteger(r[1])||r[0]>=r[1]))return null;a.sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]||x[1]-y[1]);const o:Array<[number,number]>=[];for(const r of a){if(!o.length||r[0]>o[o.length-1][1])o.push(r);else o[o.length-1][1]=Math.max(o[o.length-1][1],r[1])}return o}
